The projection regex omits `self_attn.o_proj.weight`, so only 96 tensors (6 per layer × 16) are cast to bfloat16 and the 16 `o_proj` matrices stay float32, violating Required result 1 (cast exactly the 112 listed matrices). Consequently the script asserts 96 bfloat16 tensors instead of the 112 demanded by the Required checks, so the required check "exactly 112 tensors are bfloat16" is not implemented and the mismatch would not fail loudly. Everything else (no deletions, names unchanged, sharding with oversized tensors alone, index file) is fine.
